title: Blood-brain barrier crossing biopolymer targeting c-Myc and anti-PD-1 activate primary brain lymphoma immunity: Artificial intelligence analysis.
authors: Ljubimov, Vladimir A; Sun, Tao; Wang, Jiawei; Li, Lian; Wang, Paul Z; Ljubimov, Alexander V; Holler, Eggehard; Black, Keith L; Kopecek, Jindrich; Ljubimova, Julia Y; Yang, Jiyuan
journal: Journal of controlled release : official journal of the Controlled Release Society
one_liner_zh: 该研究开发靶向c-Myc的纳米药物联合抗PD-1治疗脑淋巴瘤，虽含AI分析但核心为药物递送与免疫治疗，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma is an aggressive central nervous system neoplasm with poor response to pharmacological treatment, partially due to insufficient drug delivery across blood-brain barrier. In this study, we developed a novel therapy for this lymphoma by combining a targeted nanopolymer treatment with an immune checkpoint inhibitor antibody (anti-PD-1). A N-(2-hydroxypropyl)methacrylamide copolymer-based nanoconjugate was designed to block tumor cell c-Myc oncogene expression by antisense oligonucleotide. Angiopep-2 peptide was conjugated to the copolymer to facilitate nanodrug crossing of the blood-brain barrier. Systemically administered polymeric nanodrug, alone or in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitor antibody anti-PD-1, was tested in syngeneic mouse model of A20 intracranial brain lymphoma. There was no significant survival difference between saline- and free anti-PD-1-treated groups. However, significant survival advantage vs. saline was observed upon treatment with nanodrug bearing Angiopep-2, H6 (6 histidines for endosome escape), and c-Myc antisense alone and especially when it was combined with anti-PD-1 antibody. Animal survival after combined treatment was also significantly increased vs. free anti-PD-1. Artificial Intelligence-assisted analysis of gene expression database after RNA-seq of tumors was used to find novel immune pathways, molecular targets and the most effective multifunctional drugs together with future drug prediction for brain lymphoma in vivo model. Spectral flow cytometry and RNA-seq analysis revealed a robust activation of tumor infiltrating T lymphocytes with enhanced interferon gamma signaling and polarization to M1-type macrophages in treated tumors, which was confirmed by immunofluorescence staining. In summary, a new effective blood-brain barrier crossing nano immuno therapeutic system was developed that effectively blocked tumor c-Myc acting in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitor anti-PD-1 to treat primary brain lymphoma. The treatment improved survival of tumor-bearing animals through activation of both the adaptive and innate immune responses.
abstract_zh: 原发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤是一种侵袭性中枢神经系统肿瘤，对药物治疗反应不佳，部分原因在于药物通过血脑屏障的递送不足。在本研究中，我们通过将靶向纳米聚合物治疗与免疫检查点抑制剂抗体（抗PD-1）相结合，开发了一种针对该淋巴瘤的新型疗法。设计了一种基于N-(2-羟丙基)甲基丙烯酰胺共聚物的纳米偶联物，通过反义寡核苷酸阻断肿瘤细胞c-Myc癌基因表达。将Angiopep-2肽偶联至共聚物上，以促进纳米药物穿越血脑屏障。在A20颅内脑淋巴瘤的同基因小鼠模型中，测试了系统性给予的聚合物纳米药物单独使用或与免疫检查点抑制剂抗体抗PD-1联合使用的效果。生理盐水和游离抗PD-1治疗组之间没有显著的生存差异。然而，与生理盐水相比，携带Angiopep-2、H6（6个组氨酸用于内体逃逸）和c-Myc反义序列的纳米药物单独治疗，尤其是与抗PD-1抗体联合使用时，观察到显著的生存优势。联合治疗后的动物生存率也显著高于游离抗PD-1治疗。利用人工智能辅助分析肿瘤RNA-seq后的基因表达数据库，以发现新的免疫通路、分子靶点和最有效的多功能药物，并对脑淋巴瘤体内模型进行未来药物预测。光谱流式细胞术和RNA-seq分析显示，在治疗肿瘤中，肿瘤浸润T淋巴细胞被强烈激活，干扰素γ信号增强，并极化为M1型巨噬细胞，这通过免疫荧光染色得到证实。总之，我们开发了一种新的有效穿越血脑屏障的纳米免疫治疗系统，该系统有效阻断肿瘤c-Myc，并与免疫检查点抑制剂抗PD-1联合治疗原发性脑淋巴瘤。该治疗通过激活适应性免疫和固有免疫反应，提高了荷瘤动物的生存率。
